payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped FrickObservableStore<Model>: generic Compose-friendly observable object cache + sync loop over FrickSyncSocket. Subscribes to one object type, caches by id, exposes StateFlow<List<Model>>. Applies snapshot+live upserts, drops rows on decoder-null tombstone and on explicit removed:{type,id}[] (FR-144 forward-compat), re-subscribes on reconnect. 7 new unit tests (snapshot/upsert/append/tombstone/remove/re-snapshot/type-filter). Gradle :frick:testDebugUnitTest BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 7 tests 0 failures; pnpm typecheck exit 0.
